title: Late registrations for employment related securities
text:
When to register

 If you do not register your employment related securities scheme with HMRC, you may lose tax benefits for you and your employees.

 Find out when to register your employment related securities scheme .

 If you miss the deadline 

 You’ll need to contact us in writing if you miss the deadline to:

 • submit an Enterprise Management Incentives notification

 • register a new Company Share Option Plan ( CSOP ) (also known as Enterprise Management Incentives 2 ( EMI2 ))

 • register a new Save As You Earn scheme

 • register a new Share Incentive Plan scheme

 You’ll need to explain why you missed the deadline. You can contact us:

 • by email, at  shareschemes@hmrc.gov.uk 

 • by post, at the following address:

Charities, Savings and International 1
HMRC
BX9 1AU

 If you have a reasonable excuse 

 If we accept you have a reasonable excuse for missing the deadline, we’ll explain the next steps. 

 These will include how to: 

 • register your scheme late 

 • submit any late returns — we may ask you to use our secure file transfer service to do this

 • submit any late Enterprise Management Incentives notifications 

 Late filing penalties 

 If you submit a late return, we may charge you late filing penalties.  You can appeal a late filing penalty .
changeNote: Information has been added to confirm that Company Share Option Plans (CSOP) can also be known as Enterprise Management Incentives 2 (EMI2).
